messages:
Maya: quick check — I need p50/p95/p99 and time-to-first-token (TTFT) slices for the new embed-v2 rollout. Where should I grab the canonical panels and a PromQL snippet I can paste into the PR?
Tyler: grafana: ML Latency (needlepoint) is the one we use for model slices — https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ml-latency/needlepoint
Tyler: panels: 'TTFT by model' (use model_version variable), 'tokens/sec (inference)' and the pxx latency heatmap.
Olivia: if you want a short promql for p95 TTFT per model_version try this in Explore: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ml_inference_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_version))
```
Olivia: and tokens/sec (global-ish):
```
sum(rate(ml_inference_tokens_total[1m])) by (model_version)
```
Maya: nice — do we have an example of filtering by route or by request_size (seq len) so I can show both short/long seq behavior?
Tyler: use labels: route and seq_bucket. e.g. add `| model_version="embed-v2",seq_bucket=">128"` to the sum(...) clauses or use grafana template vars to slice.
Kevin: FYI we just had an alert noise spike on ml-ttft-p95 last week when embed-v2 warmed cold caches. Current alert: p95 > 0.35s for more than 3m.
Maya: for embed-v2 we're seeing p95 ~0.6s for certain slices (seq>512) but tokens/sec is low. I want to propose alert change to avoid false positives.
Kevin: propose: require both p95 > 0.6s AND tokens/sec > 50 for 5m to fire, or add a cooldown for recent deploys. Also add model_version label to the alert so it only targets specific rollouts.
Olivia: agree. Also recommend adding a recovery condition: if p95 reduces but token rate spikes, we keep it firing for 2m so ops can see traffic impacts.
sre-bot: Alert ml-ttft-p95 fired (embed-v2, seq>512) at 3123458500 — https://alerts.redwood.com/alerts/3245
Maya: can someone drop a concrete alert expression I can link in the PR?
Kevin: here's a starting point (tweak durations as needed):
```
( histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ml_inference_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_version, seq_bucket)) > 0.6 )
and ( sum(rate(ml_inference_tokens_total[5m])) by (model_version, seq_bucket) > 50 )
```
Kevin: attach `for: 5m` and `labels: {model_version}` in the alert rule.
Maya: perfect — I'll add that to PR #4321 and point to the grafana panel and the jaeger sample you recommended.
Tyler: for jaeger/trace sampling, use trace: `service=ml-inference` and tag `model_version=embed-v2` — sample traces around the slow TTFT and look for KV cache cold path.
Olivia: link to jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.com/search?service=ml-inference&tags=model_version%3Dembed-v2
Maya: thanks all — I'll also include a note to watch tokens/sec and not just raw latency. Ping me for review when PR is up. :thumbsup:
Kevin: will review after lunch.
Maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/infra/merge_requests/4321 — includes grafana panel links, promql, and alert change proposal.
Olivia: LGTM from me once CI passes.
Maya: closing the loop — will run a dashboard snapshot + add a small runbook note about TTFT vs tokens/sec for embed rollouts.
